ruleRoutingGuidance.belongs: the GitHub account a fleet bills to, read across all its repositories: plan allowances, billing usage, account-wide limits
ruleRoutingGuidance.excludes: one repository's workflows and Actions behaviour — git-github; the fleet's own membership, updates and pack directory — the engine's fleet pack

pitch: GitHub bills Actions to the account, not to a repository, so a fleet can run out of its included storage while every repository looks fine on its own. Declared on a fleet manager, this pack's daily task reads the account's plan and billing usage report, forecasts the month's storage to its last day, and keeps one issue open with a chart and the repositories driving it whenever the allowance would run out.
